 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Rotate the input into a left half, reflect across both axes as a 3-band motif."""
    left = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    band = [row + row[::-1] for row in left]
    return band + band[::-1] + band


if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo = [
        [2, 3, 3, 4],
        [3, 0, 3, 3],
        [2, 3, 3, 3],
        [2, 2, 0, 3],
        [2, 3, 1, 3],
        [1, 3, 4, 3],
        [3, 3, 3, 1],
        [3, 3, 4, 4],
    ]
    expected = [
        [4,4,3,3,3,3,4,4], [1,3,3,3,3,3,3,1],
        [3,4,3,1,1,3,4,3], [3,1,3,2,2,3,1,3],
        [3,0,2,2,2,2,0,3], [3,3,3,2,2,3,3,3],
        [3,3,0,3,3,0,3,3], [4,3,3,2,2,3,3,4],
        [4,3,3,2,2,3,3,4], [3,3,0,3,3,0,3,3],
        [3,3,3,2,2,3,3,3], [3,0,2,2,2,2,0,3],
        [3,1,3,2,2,3,1,3], [3,4,3,1,1,3,4,3],
        [1,3,3,3,3,3,3,1], [4,4,3,3,3,3,4,4],
        [4,4,3,3,3,3,4,4], [1,3,3,3,3,3,3,1],
        [3,4,3,1,1,3,4,3], [3,1,3,2,2,3,1,3],
        [3,0,2,2,2,2,0,3], [3,3,3,2,2,3,3,3],
        [3,3,0,3,3,0,3,3], [4,3,3,2,2,3,3,4],
    ]
    assert transform(demo) == expected
    test = [[6, 6, 6, 6] for _ in range(7)]
    result = transform(test)
    assert len(result) == 21 and all(len(row) == 8 for row in result)
    assert all(value == 6 for row in result for value in row)
    print(result)
    print("demo reproduced; test dimensions 21x8")
